script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. As the Sun fires its last degree through your 1st House on the cusp of Gemini, Venus your ruling planet is forming an intense square to Saturn in your 10th House of Career, blocking your professional momentum cold. In your 7th House, Jupiter in Cancer is sextiling your natal Moon, which means a partner or potential love is about to open up emotionally in ways you did not expect. Singles, do not swipe past someone steady — that quiet energy is your match. For money, resist signing any contract until after Venus leaves that square, or you will regret the terms. A surprise message from someone you haven't heard from in years is heading your way — keep your phone close. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss what the Moon is about to reveal.
